players.product: industrial & electronics gases (N2, He, specialty) for fabs

quarterly_data.signal: As of 30 September 2025 the transaction price allocated to remaining performance obligations was approximately $26 billion, including fixed-charge contract provisions of the on-site and sale-of-equipment supply modes; Air Products estimates about half will be recognized over the next five years and the balance thereafter. The figure excludes expected revenue from new on-site plants not yet on-stream.
quarterly_data.figure: remaining performance obligations ~$26 billion (as of 30 September 2025)

quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditures (non-GAAP) totaled $5.1 billion in fiscal year 2025, a 2% decrease from $5.2 billion in fiscal year 2024. Air Products expects fiscal year 2026 capital expenditures of approximately $4 billion, of which approximately $1 billion is expected to be dedicated to traditional industrial gas projects.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 capex $5.1 billion (2% decrease vs $5.2 billion); FY2026 expected ~$4 billion (~$1 billion traditional industrial gas projects)

quarterly_data.signal: Approximately $5.0 billion of Air Products' unconditional purchase obligations relate to helium, mostly falling after fiscal year 2030. They cover crude feedstock supply to its North American helium refining plants and refined helium bought from sources worldwide, under medium- to long-term helium sourcing agreements with take-if-tendered provisions. No supplier is named.
quarterly_data.figure: helium unconditional purchase obligations ~$5.0 billion (majority after fiscal year 2030)

quarterly_data.signal: Approximately $4.0 billion of Air Products' unconditional purchase obligations are open purchase orders for plant and equipment, of which approximately $1 billion relates to the NEOM Green Hydrogen Project. The terms generally allow Air Products to reschedule, cancel or otherwise modify them.
quarterly_data.figure: open purchase orders for plant and equipment ~$4.0 billion (~$1 billion NEOM Green Hydrogen Project)
